criteria.text: Relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis (FDA indication; approval criterion 2)
Patient is 18 years of age or older
Prescribed by or in consultation with a neurologist or a prescriber that specializes in MS
Ineffective response due to continued clinical relapse, intolerance, or contraindication to two or more MS drugs within the last 12 months
For women of reproductive potential, provider attests patient is not pregnant and will not become pregnant while treated
Not prescribed concurrently with other disease-modifying therapies for MS

notes: Partial encoding of Alaska Medicaid Briumvi (ublituximab-xiiy), a CD20-directed cytolytic antibody. Version: 1; Original: 3/9/2023; Approval: 4/21/2023; Effective: 6/1/2023.

Encoded: three closed adult relapsing MS indications, approval criteria 1-5 and denial criteria 2-3. Denial criterion 1 (failure to meet approval criteria) is covered by the approval clauses. Prior therapy and reproductive status are attestations.
Duration (notes only): initial approval up to 6 months; reauthorization up to 12 months if the prescriber documents disease improvement or stabilization.
Quantity and dosing (notes only): initial 150 mg, followed by 450 mg 2 weeks later; maintenance 450 mg every 24 weeks. HCPCS J3590. No numeric quantity enforcement.

Cautions (notes only): test quantitative serum immunoglobulins before starting; low serum immunoglobulins require immunologist evaluation before treatment. Delay administration with an active infection until resolved or when receiving live-attenuated vaccines. Premedicate with methylprednisolone (or equivalent corticosteroid) and an antihistamine before each infusion. May cause fetal harm.
PDL status unknown: PDF is silent. Kesimpta is an encoded CD20 MS peer; alternative eligibility requires separate evaluation.
Remaining gaps: documentation verification, authorization duration, reauthorization response, dosing, quantity enforcement and cautions require manual review.
